span.p:
Change author / agent operator
[Person]
Writes the specification, selects the
capability profile, is accountable

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Governance or security owner
[Person]
Maintains policy, tool register,
risk classes and checks

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reviewer / code owner
[Person]
Approves or rejects. Records licence
and exception decisions

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Governed change workflow
[Software system — this repository]
Governance artefacts, specifications, agent
instructions, CI checks, per-change evidence

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
AI coding tool
[External system]
Claude Code or GitHub Copilot. Enforces
sandbox and permissions for some tool paths

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Model provider
[External system]
Receives the context the tool sends

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Source-control and CI host
[External system]
GitHub. Runs CI. Enforces the
ruleset only as configured

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Advisory and licence data
[External system]
OSV.dev, deps.dev

svg.text: C4 Level 1 — System context: governed AI-assisted change workflow
